debug.description: If true, do not cleanup temporary files

solver_opts.description: List of command-line options passed to the solver (clasp); empty means use defaults unless at least one option is provided, in which case defaults are suppressed

grounder_opts.description: List of command-line options passed to the grounder (gringo)

preprocessor_opts.description: List of command-line options passed to the preprocessor (cudf2lp)

encodings.description: List of custom encoding files to append; if non-empty, the default encoding is not used

input_files.description: List of input CUDF files; if empty, input is read from stdin

output_file.description: Output CUDF file path; if empty, output goes to stdout
